title: asc
author: AI Weaver
intro_narrative: In soot-stained x, Inspector Evelyn Harrow and Constable Thomas Wren are drawn into a death at sdv—a cramped lodging house where the signs of burglary feel theatrically arranged. Ink, wax, and a physician’s needle form a trail through taverns, printworks, and church vestries toward a single set of initials: asc.

required_evidence: fused sealing-wax bead with stamp impression
coat button with green silk thread
required_motive: Silencing a witness to protect forged shipping documents and social standing (reputation/self-preservation).

phases.name: Phase 1 — sdfbadfb
phases.objective: sdfbadfb. Determine the manner of death at sdv and whether the burglary is real or staged.

phases.name: Phase 2 — The Ink Trail
phases.objective: Follow the victim’s last movements: confirm the ink source and identify who met him under initials.

phases.name: Phase 3 — Wax, God, and Laudanum
phases.objective: Trace the seal and the means: connect the staircase-stamp letters to church records and a medical instrument.

phases.name: Phase 4 — Towpath & Reckoning
phases.objective: Recover discarded property and confront the culprit at the constabulary office using the full chain of evidence.

x.description: A soot-stained seam between city and countryside: brickworks, narrow terraces, and the river’s slow traffic under a ceiling of permanent smoke. Gas lamps burn through winter fog; coal-dust hangs on the tongue.

visual_metadata.setting: Industrial fringe-town gloom: damp cobbles, coal smoke, and a river tang; visibility reduced to a few lantern-lengths.

surfaces_and_containers.spatial_relationship: Along the curb under a flickering gas lamp

sdv.description: A cramped lodging house wedged between shops. Upstairs, the air is damp and mean: a thin quilted bed, a small desk with a guttered candle, a grudging fireplace, and a cracked leather settee. A cheap mirror clouds above a washstand; everything smells of damp wool and spent grease.
items: fused sealing-wax bead with stamp impression
coat button with green silk thread
clues: In the victim’s throat is a neat puncture rather than a gash, suggesting a slender implement.
A smear of printer’s ink marks the victim’s cuff, fresh and tacky.
The victim’s pocket holds a torn scrap with the letters “a s c” and a partial address pointing toward sdv.
The window-latch is forced from inside, staged to resemble an intruder.
Ash on the hearth contains a fused bead of sealing wax with a distinctive stamp impression.
A button from an expensive coat is found under the settee; its thread matches asc’s distinctive green silk mending.

clues: A tavern ledger shows the victim met “asc” earlier, though the page has been scraped and rewritten.

Crowe & Son Printworks.description: A brisk-walk printworks where the air bites of turpentine and ink. Presses thud like a mechanical heart; compositors work in rows beneath high windows filmed with grime.

St. Brigid’s Church.description: A soot-darkened stone church among terraces. Inside, cold air and candle smoke cling to old hymnals. Footsteps echo like reprimand; the vestry kettle hisses softly.
clues: At St. Brigid’s, Reverend Flint recalls delivering a registered letter to asc the day before, and asc asked about poison inquiries in a sermon on ‘quiet sins’.

The riverside towpath.description: A muddy towpath behind warehouses where rats are bold as cats. Barges creak in thick, dark water; fog tastes of iron. Weeds and river-slime hide what a hurried walker may discard.
clues: On the towpath near x, Wren finds a weighted purse containing the victim’s watch, as if discarded during a hurried walk from sdv.

Inspector Evelyn Harrow.role: Lead investigator; drives deductions and confrontations.
Inspector Evelyn Harrow.persona: Precise, unsentimental, and quietly relentless; speaks in short declarative sentences, letting silence pressure the room.

knowledge_about_others.Constable Thomas Wren: Eager, observant; useful for legwork and retrieval under furniture and along the towpath.
knowledge_about_others.Dr. Gideon Pell: Reliable medical mind; uncomfortable with scandal, but keeps accurate records.
knowledge_about_others.Mrs. Lottie Ashby: Protective of her tavern; responds better to calm certainty than threats.
knowledge_about_others.Mr. Silas Crowe: Proud tradesman; defensive unless met with professional respect.
knowledge_about_others.Reverend Ambrose Flint: Cautious keeper of confidences; yields when framed as preventing further harm.

Inspector Evelyn Harrow.abilities: May 'Chain Evidence': after obtaining any two corroborating clues, can unlock a new line of questioning in the next interview scene.

required_evidence: fused sealing-wax bead with stamp impression
conditional_behaviors.reaction: Harrow lays out ink, wax, and laudanum as a single narrative, making denial costly and specific.

Constable Thomas Wren.role: Local constable; searches, fetches, and confirms routes and timings.
Constable Thomas Wren.persona: Earnest, quick to react, sometimes blurts conclusions; respectful to Harrow and eager to be useful.

knowledge_about_others.Mrs. Lottie Ashby: Knows which regulars cause trouble; wary of police attention.
knowledge_about_others.Mr. Silas Crowe: Locally respected; dislikes constables near his books.
knowledge_about_others.Reverend Ambrose Flint: Well-liked; not accustomed to being pressed.

Constable Thomas Wren.abilities: May 'Conduct a Search': reveals one hidden SceneObject in the current location’s surfaces/containers per phase.

conditional_behaviors.reaction: Wren checks under the settee and retrieves the coat button if it has not been found.
Wren sweeps the towpath weeds and locates the weighted purse, then opens it to find the pocket-watch.

Dr. Gideon Pell.role: Physician; determines cause of death and tracks controlled substances and instruments.
Dr. Gideon Pell.persona: Clinical, careful with words; bristles at insinuations but respects evidence and proper procedure.

knowledge_about_others.Inspector Evelyn Harrow: Trusts her judgment; appreciates her restraint.
knowledge_about_others.asc: Signed out laudanum under asc’s name; noticed a distinctive seal and controlling demeanor.

Dr. Gideon Pell.abilities: Can 'Authenticate Medical Evidence': confirms whether a puncture matches a needle-like implement and whether laudanum could still resistance.

conditional_behaviors.reaction: Pell confirms the laudanum quantity is consistent with sedation and notes the missing hypodermic needle from his cabinet.

Mrs. Lottie Ashby.role: Landlady of The Black Lamp; gatekeeper to tavern movements and ledger records.
Mrs. Lottie Ashby.persona: Tough, pragmatic, and wary; speaks in measured bursts, protective of her business and patrons until cornered by specifics.

knowledge_about_others.asc: A well-dressed man who paid her to keep quiet; had a button once mended with green thread.
knowledge_about_others.Mr. Harlan Sykes: Came in anxious, kept watching the door; met asc.

Mrs. Lottie Ashby.secret: Accepted hush money to allow ledger alteration, fearing debt to the brewer and loss of the tavern.

conditional_behaviors.reaction: Ashby admits the initials match the man she was paid to conceal, and yields the ledger with the scraped entry.

Mr. Silas Crowe.role: Owner of Crowe & Son Printworks; provides ink provenance and private-job practices.
Mr. Silas Crowe.persona: Proud, defensive, trade-minded; hates police disruption but respects technical competence and firm civility.

knowledge_about_others.asc: Commissioned discreet private letters; paid in sovereigns; demanded type melted after; used a staircase-like seal motif in headings.
knowledge_about_others.Mrs. Lottie Ashby: Occasional tavern contact through delivery boys and pressmen.

Mr. Silas Crowe.secret: Runs discreet private print jobs for gentlemen and destroys type on request; fears being implicated in fraud.

conditional_behaviors.reaction: Crowe identifies the proprietary night-black ink and admits a client using initials 'asc' ordered private work tied to a seal impression.

Reverend Ambrose Flint.role: Clergyman at St. Brigid’s; conduit for registered letters and overheard moral panic.
Reverend Ambrose Flint.persona: Gentle, careful, and principled; speaks with pastoral gravity, reluctant to betray confidences unless it prevents harm.

knowledge_about_others.asc: Received a registered letter with a staircase seal; asked about 'quiet sins' and whether laudanum could still a struggle.
knowledge_about_others.Inspector Evelyn Harrow: Responds to her framing of truth as protection for others.

Reverend Ambrose Flint.secret: Withheld details of asc’s questions initially to preserve confidences, then regretted it after learning of the death.

conditional_behaviors.reaction: Seeing evidence of record-tampering, Flint admits asc’s registered letter and his questions about poisoning and 'quieting' a witness.
